sb-drain.desc: second-brain drain (Work Log entries from queued commits, note freeze on PR merge)
sb-drain.note: drives Codex luna 6 xhigh through codex-headless for `/sb-ticket-log --from-commits` and `/sb-ticket-finish`. codex-headless falls back to Claude Sonnet when Codex refuses (auth, quota, 5xx). The post-commit hook only enqueues, because a hook that blocks on a model call makes committing unusable.

thread-status.desc: thread-status (PR url, CI and vault note into thread files)
thread-status.note: gh only feeds the PR and CI fields; the vault note is a local lookup and still persists without it
